purpose: Teach: 市政/不正確/手引き/ライフサイクル/移設/定率/不払い/ファクス

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、市政と連携した防犯活動をされてますね
lines.en: I see police work alongside the city government on crime prevention initiatives.
lines.style: Measured, slightly formal. Acknowledging tone—gentle upswing at the end. Not challenging, but genuinely curious about the work. Observant.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、不正確な目撃情報の整理もされますね
lines.en: And you also organize witness statements, even the uncertain ones.
lines.style: Continuing smoothly from the previous thought. Slightly impressed. Even pace, warm. A small nod embedded in the voice—recognizing the detail work.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、防犯手引きを市民に配布されますね
lines.en: You distribute crime prevention guides to residents too.
lines.style: Still warm and observant. Building a picture. Light, matter-of-fact delivery. No strain—just listing what he's noticing you do.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、犯罪のライフサイクル分析もされますね
lines.en: And crime pattern analysis—you look at the broader lifecycle of incidents.
lines.style: Slightly more impressed now. Slower on 「ライフサイクル」 equivalent—showing he sees this takes real work. Genuine interest, not flattering.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、捜査本部の移設も検討されますね
lines.en: Even relocating investigation headquarters when needed.
lines.style: Continuing the building list with steady respect. Matter-of-fact, but the word 「移設」 gets a tiny weight—he notices it's not simple. No rush.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、罰金の定率改定にも対応されますね
lines.en: And adapting to changes in fine structures.
lines.style: Same steady warmth. Slightly quicker here—less dramatic work, but still details that matter. Keeping pace even with the administrative side of things.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、罰金不払い案件にも対応されますね
lines.en: You handle cases where fines go unpaid too.
lines.style: Still warm but a touch more grounded. The reality of the work—not glamorous, but necessary. Slight weight on 「不払い」. He sees the whole job.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、緊急時はファクス連絡網も活用されますね
lines.en: And when something urgent happens, you activate the emergency fax network.
lines.style: Warmer here, almost intimate. He's moved from listing work to understanding how you actually *move* when it matters. Eyes a little closer. Genuine admiration underneath.
